Hi there, and thanks so much for contacting Leafy! 🌿

I'm sorry for any inconvenience, but we don't offer phone support. There are a few other ways to reach us, though:

- **Chat:** 8am–8pm, Monday to Saturday (your local time)
- **Email:** help@leafy.example, and we reply within 1 business day
- **Plant Care Specialists (chat):** 9am–5pm, Monday to Friday (your local time), great for any plant care questions

I'm happy to help right here in chat, too. What can I do for you today?
